rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AA expanded blastocyst, but several image-specific details appear overinterpreted or fabricated (exact ICM location, debris/vacuoles, mild granularity) beyond what can be confidently confirmed from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, sperm quality, diagnosis, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat strong assumptions about alcohol effect size and inferred blast yield.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, prognosis, and general counseling, but includes some less guideline-based recommendations (ERA/EMMA-ALICE, routine estradiol addition, broad adjuncts like GH/DHEA/CoQ10) and overstates certainty around protocol changes.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer counseling, lifestyle modification, luteal support considerations, and future cycle planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care.
